notes.title: Steam Page is Live!
notes.notes:
[b]Devlog #1: The Journey So Far
[/b]
Hey everyone!

The Catlands Steam page is finally live! This project began as a small game jam idea but turned into something we’re proud of. Over the past 1.5 years, we’ve balanced development with life, improved the core gameplay, and even won a few local festival prizes.

What started as a solo project now has a small team, and we’re ready to share more. Expect updates and devlogs once in a 2-3 weeks as we work toward releasing a demo in the coming months.

Thanks for your support, and stay tuned!
[i]
The Catlands Team[/i]
